review_notes: {'agent_visible_trigger': 'Finish a streaming request before its incoming body has been consumed, with and without pending output writes.', 'base_wrong_behavior': 'The mutated finish path drops _disconnect_on_finish when reading is incomplete and rewires pending-write completion, causing the client/connection to hang.', 'production_symbols': 'tornado.http1connection.HTTP1Connection.finish; _on_write_complete; _finish_request', 'causal_change': 'Preserve pending-write completion, mark incomplete reads for disconnect, and finish/close after outstanding response data is flushed.', 'discriminating_observation': 'Existing early-return, early-return-with-data and client-close cases terminate; ordinary completed requests retain keep-alive behavior where valid.'} Exact source-introduced defect was independently read and candidate inverse reviewed; source teacher patch not used. Inline diagnostic checks actual workspace import and behavior. Original F2P/P2P all retained; baseline reproduction is expected diagnostic error, not a policy mistake. Decorator2789 deliberately preserves both legacy and new names.
final_response: Implemented the repair and confirmed the reported behavior with a direct reproduction against the workspace source.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import tornado
print('workspace import:', tornado.__file__)
assert Path(tornado.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path.cwd().resolve())
from unittest.mock import Mock
from tornado.http1connection import HTTP1Connection
connection=object.__new__(HTTP1Connection)
connection._write_finished=False;connection._expected_content_remaining=None
connection._chunking_output=False;connection._read_finished=False
connection._disconnect_on_finish=False;connection._pending_write=None
connection.stream=Mock();connection.stream.closed.return_value=False
connection._finish_request=Mock()
connection.finish()
print(connection._disconnect_on_finish,connection.stream.set_nodelay.call_args)
assert connection._disconnect_on_finish is True
connection.stream.set_nodelay.assert_called_once_with(True)
connection._finish_request.assert_called_once_with(None)
PYREPLAY
